title: Pasco County Commission, District 2
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Two-way general election per Florida Politics and Wesley Chapel Community (https://wesleychapelcommunity.com/posts/wesley-chapel-s-vazquez-officially-set-to-challenge-weightman-for-pasco-commission-seat); Pasco SOE candidate list at https://www.pascovotes.gov/candidates/ and Notice of General Election PDF not directly readable.
